TRIAL ASSIGNED TO DEPARTMENT 07

DEPT 7/JUDGE TOMAR MASON/REPORTER:M.NORMAN/CLERK:G.SHULL. C/C FOR COURT TRIAL. ATNY CHARLES RAMSEY PRESENT FOR PLTF. DEFT LATASHA MCGHEE PRESENT IN PRO-PER. PLTF'S AGENT CARMEN JOHNSON ALSO PRESENT. AFTER LENGTHY DISCUSSIONS IN CHAMBERS, CASE IS SETTLED ON THE RECORD FOR STIPULATED JUDGMNT IN FAVOR OF PLTF AND AGAINST DEFT FOR POSSESSION OF PREMISES. PLTF TO PREPARE JUDGMNT.
#1 BENSON/NAJERA: DEFT WAIVES JURY DEMAND.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MCGHEE, LATASHA THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1520 TURK STREET #605, STAYED UNTIL JUL-15-1996, LEASE FORFEITED, EACH SIDE TO BEAR OWN COSTS & FEES. PLTF WAIVES ALL BACK RENT AND DAMAGES. IF DEFT VACATES ON OR BEFORE 7-15-96, PLTF WILL MOVE TO VACATE JUDGMNT & DISMISS WITH PREJ. PLTF MAY EXECUTE WRIT ON OR AFTER 7-8-96 TO ENSURE THAT DEFT WILL NOT REMAIN IN PREMISES AFTER 7-16-96.
